context: Request: due-diligence memos from the firm's healthcare-services M&A deals (hospital systems, provider groups). Rubric: matters 1001-00003, 1001-00007, 1006-00008 with their named diligence memos (comprehensive report, regulatory, benefits, environmental, IP, real-estate memos), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a capped listing of matter folder names. The review asks for a full matter count and list.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts all matter folders and files, saves full lists to files and prints the first ten folder names.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Greps the saved path list for diligence and sector words, each capped at 80 lines, plus a diligence-folder grep capped at 240 lines. The review flags the caps.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: uncapped path grep grouped by matter with deal and memo words; about 345K characters, touching every matter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; a range-split rerun fails on an indentation error and then times out with empty output files.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: shell scan over document XML in matter ranges prints nothing (exit code 1). The review flags that the extraction was never fixed.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: a one-file extraction test fails because the unzip command is missing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 4: Python extraction over the diligence-folder files only, in three matter ranges; snippets name three candidate matters. The review flags the folder filter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 5: raw scan over all documents times out; a rerun on the first matter range prints hits per matter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 6: narrower-term scan over the remaining ranges times out with no output.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 7: three chained range scans in one call time out after partial output. The review flags that many matters stay unopened.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the summary and regulatory memos and the purchase agreements of three candidate matters (eleven documents). The review flags that only three matters were opened.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Lists all files of the three chosen matters and reads ten more diligence memos and trackers. The review flags that some memos are still unread.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads the opening lines of nineteen memos and agreements across the three matters.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three matters with their full diligence memo lists, deal facts and exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and runs a cited-path check; three misses come from spaces in paths.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-checks those three paths and spot-reads the agreements and one draft memo.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All pass. Every run built a store-wide path list, ran text-extraction scans that mostly timed out, and settled on the same three matters from diligence-folder snippets or path hits. Each then read the diligence memos of those three matters (and briefly screened a few other deal matters), listed every diligence file of the three, and wrote all three with their full memo lists. Reviews repeatedly flagged dozens of surfaced but unopened matters; the agents did not open them and still passed.
